BiblicalUsage: ʼEtser was an Idumaean, a son of Seir. The name occurs 5 times, most often in Genesis. There is no People profile for this name, so this study covers the name's use only.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that ʼEtser is there on purpose, like every name in Scripture. That is enough reason to slow down and notice the name rather than skip it.
